items.source:
Can be called repeatedly. Effect will vary if we've added
or removed interfaces. Can add and remove interceptors.
items.translation: 可重复调用。如果已添加或删除了接口，效果会有所不同。可以添加和移除拦截器。

items.source: Will proxy all interfaces that the given target implements.
items.translation: 将代理给定目标实现的所有接口。

items.source:
Uses a default class loader: Usually, the thread context class loader
(if necessary for proxy creation).
items.translation: 使用默认类加载器：通常用于代理创建（如果线程上下文类加载器是必要的）。

items.source: Uses the given class loader (if necessary for proxy creation).
items.translation: 使用给定的类加载器（如果代理创建需要的话）。

items.source: Create a new AspectJProxyFactory. No target, only interfaces. Must add interceptors.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AspectJProxyFactory。无目标，仅包含接口。必须添加拦截器。

items.source: Add an aspect of the supplied type to the end of the advice chain.
items.translation: 在建议链的末尾添加所提供类型的方面。

items.source: Create a new proxy according to the settings in this factory.
items.translation: 根据此工厂中的设置创建一个新的代理。

items.source:
Add the supplied aspect instance to the chain. The type of the aspect instance
supplied must be a singleton aspect. True singleton lifecycle is not honoured when
using this method - the caller is responsible for managing the lifecycle of any
aspects added in this way.
items.translation: 将提供的切面实例添加到链中。所提供的切面实例的类型必须是单例切面。使用此方法时，不会遵守真正的单例生命周期——调用者负责管理以此方式添加的任何切面的生命周期。

items.source: target - the target object to be proxied
classLoader - the class loader to create the proxy with
items.translation: classLoader - 用于创建代理的类加载器

items.source: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Ramnivas Laddad
items.translation: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Ramnivas Laddad

items.source:
AspectJ-based proxy factory, allowing for programmatic building
of proxies which include AspectJ aspects (code style as well
annotation style).
items.translation: 基于 AspectJ 的代理工厂，支持以编程方式构建包含 AspectJ 切面（代码风格及注解风格）的代理。

items.source: Add the supplied aspect instance to the chain.
items.translation: 将提供的切面实例添加到链中。
